summary.name: AI STUDIO (DeepBrain AI)
summary.one_liner: AI STUDIO is a cloud-based AI video generator from DeepBrain AI for making avatar videos, text-to-video content, and multilingual dubbing.
use_cases: Creating HR and corporate training videos
Making e-learning courses with SCORM export
Translating and dubbing videos into other languages
Producing short-form YouTube, TikTok, or Reels content with avatars
Turning scripts, documents, or URLs into narrated videos
Building interactive avatars for customer support on web or kiosks
summary.what_it_does: AI STUDIO generates videos from a pasted script, uploaded document, URL, product, or topic, with AI avatars and narration. The page cites 2,000+ ready-to-use avatars, custom avatars from a short recording, and photo and product avatars. Text-to-speech and voice cloning cover 150+ languages, and dubbing includes automatic lip-sync and proofreading. Editing supports quizzes, branching scenarios, and SCORM export for LMS use. Enterprise features listed include a RESTful API, webhooks, role-based access control, and claimed ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, and GDPR compliance.
notable: Avatar-based video with 2,000+ avatars plus voice cloning and lip-sync dubbing in 150+ languages
SCORM export and quiz/branching tools for training courses
RESTful API and webhooks for enterprise integration
caveats: Free plan has limited credits; video length, avatar options, and exports are capped, and paid plans unlock higher limits
Generative features consume credits (plans list Free 16, Personal 60, Team 150 monthly credits), with add-on packs for purchase
Enterprise pricing is custom and not published on the page
